rows.en: I need to open up some distance first...!
If I close in all at once now... I can do this!
It's too close! Then... I just have to go for it!
Zeorymer, full power!
Zeorymer can do it!
We can do this, Masato!
So this is Wind!? Its mobility is amazing, but...!
As long as I don't let them combo-attack... I should win!
With that much firepower... a long fight is bad for us!
I can't let it cause any more earthquakes!
All those missiles... I hope they don't set each other off...
Power equal to Zeorymer's...? I'll end this fast...!
Full power!
I can't go down here...!
Next time, I'm the one making the move...!
Zeorymer, now it's our turn!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Masato...
At this rate... they'll just wipe us out...!
Output's dropping... Oh no, it's going to stop moving!?
Zeorymer... please... hold out a little longer!
Damage rate... over 70%...!? At this rate...
The output... the output won't go up...!
Miku! Are you okay!? Miku!
Ma... Masato...
Dimensional Coupler System... output dropping... Masato!
Don't give up, Miku. I... no, Zeorymer is...!
Zeorymer... losing to another Hakke robot...!?
Zeorymer! Aren't you supposed to be the strongest!?
Ugh! That did... more damage than I thought!
I let my guard down! I'm sorry, Zeorymer!
Waaah! That hurt more than I expected!?
Zeorymer's armor... took this much!?
Did I... trust Zeorymer's power too much!?
Self-repair can still handle this much.
Miku! I'm sorry!
We can't keep taking hits like that! Masato!
Whoa! The Barrier isn't working!?
The system's output is dropping! Be careful!
A Hakke robot, all right...! It won't let us off easy...!
So this is the Hakkeshu's real strength...!? This is bad!
It hit us, but... we're still okay.
Zeorymer... sure is built tough.
Zeorymer won't fall to something like this!
We were fine this time, but... who knows about next time...
Outer armor damaged... It's nothing serious.
Damage like this will be repaired in no time.
I scratched it!? ...Mr. Oki's going to chew me out.
We got hit!? Miku!
Miku, how bad is Zeorymer's damage!?
Starting self-repair program... This much is no problem.
A Hakke robot, all right... It actually hit Zeorymer!
A Hakke robot's power... should be more than this, though...
I can dodge it! Hah!
Zeorymer, dodge!
Here it comes, Masato!
Unit control! Full boost!
Miku! Unit control!
I'm already on it, Masato.
Even Zeorymer can't afford to get hit that often!
That one was close...!
That attack was easy to read.
Masato, are you okay!?
Somehow. Sorry, Miku.
Hakke robot...! Zeorymer is right here!
Zeorymer, block it!
Knock it back, Zeorymer!
If I run the Dimensional Coupler System at full...!
Dimensional Coupler System, up to maximum output!
System stable. Don't worry, Masato.
I'm counting on you, Miku.
Whoa! Miku!
Masato, calm down, calm down.
Now of all times... the energy's going!?
I can't reach it...!
Miku, can't you do something?
I'll cover you!
uncertain: Shared with Rei Asuka; generic wording.

rows.en: Get back! I'll handle this with Zeorymer!
Zeorymer! Charge!
I'll defend this spot with Zeorymer!
Zeorymer can take it! Leave this to me!
Zeorymer will be fine! Get back!
I can reach it from here!
At this range... I can shoot!
Please, Zeorymer! Hit them!
They should be in range! Go, Zeorymer!
This power... it's too dangerous, but...
Do I have no choice but to use it...!?
Zeorymer... this power is... too dangerous...
But we have no choice but to fight... Masato.
If I use the Dimensional Coupler System's power...
Zeorymer... won't lose...!
I'll close in fast! Miku, back me up!
Got it, Masato!
It's not over yet!
A war of attrition is bad for us. Then!
The Dimensional Coupler System's output!?
I can't fall back... I can't fall back yet!
It's not over yet! Zeorymer... can still move!
Masato... you've grown so... so strong.
Masato! Are you all right!?
Somehow. ...But at this rate, we're in trouble!
Self-repair can handle damage like this!
Geez, Masato! Quit fooling around!
Wh-what, so it's my fault!?
Don't underestimate Zeorymer's mobility!
Full boost! Emergency evasion, Miku!
There, just like that!
Guess I'm not even needed here.
Masato, that's because you charge in too far...!
But it didn't hit, did it, Miku?
That's Zeorymer for you.
I'm working hard too, you know? Masato?
Something's wrong with the Dimensional Coupler System!?
I can't reach it...! Miku, can't you do something?
Miku, run the Dimensional Coupler System at max output...!
Output stable. It's okay, Masato.
Zeorymer... show me your power!
Giso, one of the Hakkeshu... I'll take you on!
Burrstone of the Mountains... here I come!
I'll finish this!
You faced me in battle... Be proud of that!
Masaki Kihara... you will pay for your sins with death!
Even if you are the Heavens!
Now I can surely take down Zeorymer...!
Hear the roar of the Mountain!
You'll regret making an enemy of me!
Your luck has run out!
I trust you came ready for what's coming to you!
It seems you underestimated the Mountain!
I'll end it here!
I refuse! That this Burrstone... could lose!
R-Rockfell... I...!!
Gwaaah! Me, beaten!?
I, Giso... won't go down quietly...!
At this rate, the missiles might detonate...!
Did I put too much faith in the Mountain's power!?
Burrstone... hasn't crumbled yet...!
I'll never forgive you! Zeorymeeer!
So this is the power of the Heavens...! Impossible!
Next time, come at me for real!
Nngh... You're better than I thought.
Not yet! Damage like this is nothing!
You can do this much against Burrstone?
It seems you're worthy of fighting the Mountain.
How careless of me, taking such trivial damage...!
Masaki Kihara... so you're the real thing...!!
Grrgh! Impressive, Zeorymer!
Hmph, that doesn't even count as a hit!
Laughable! You think you can fight with that!?
Pathetic!
If you want to topple a mountain, put more fight into it!
That's not enough to even shake this Burrstone!
You think so little of Burrstone...!
Masaki Kihara... do you think this is a game!?
Zeorymer! Are you underestimating me!?
Burrstone isn't as slow as it looks!
Go back and try again!
You're still too green to take on me, Giso!
What's wrong, Zeorymer...? Is that all you've got?
I'll give you credit for landing a hit.
I have countermeasures too!
Hmph, you can't even pierce this?
No... what I feared has come true!
Striking my blind spot... not bad...!
Nnghhh...! I got careless!
Out of the way! I'll do it!
I see you! Take this too!
You haven't forgotten the Mountain, have you!
Leave this to the Mountain!
Burrstone's armor can take it!
Not while I still draw breath!
Shatter to pieces!
This will be your grave!
Shoooooot!
Shooot!
Heh... Can you withstand the roar of the Mountain!?
All missile hatches, open! Be wiped from existence!
This is the trump card of Burrstone of the Mountains...!
I'll blow you away without a trace in one shot!
You'd make me use this. ...This nuclear warhead!
Taste the power of the Heavens... firsthand...!
Cry! Scream! And then... die!
Vanish! Before the power of the Heavens!
Heh heh heh... Hahahaha... Haaahahahahahaha...!
I'll smash you to pieces... heh heh heh.
So you dare approach this Zeorymer...
Touch the Heavens... and you simply vanish!
Did you think getting close would change anything?
I suppose I'll toy with you a little.
Attack program, activating...
I'll crush them...! Miku, converge the energy.
System stable... Energy convergence... starting...
Are you sure you should be standing there? Heh heh...
Calculating distance to the enemy unit...
The Lightning, equal to the Heavens...? Fool...!
Try your precious earthquakes on me... Heh heh...
Moonlight cannot reach the Heavens!
You two are useless unless you're together!
uncertain: Target assumed to be a paired unit (likely the Shi sisters / Twin Lord); 'You two'.

rows.en: The roar of the Mountain? It can't be heard in the Heavens!
I'll annihilate you, not a speck of dust left...!
Vanish before the power of Hades...!
You challenge this Zeorymer with a trick that cheap!?
This farce... is over...
I am Masaki Kihara! I don't run and I don't hide!
Heh heh heh heh heh... Hahahahahaha...
Don't tell me Zeorymer is...!? Miku... you!
...This is fine... This is how it should be... Masato...
They landed a direct hit on this Zeorymer!?
On me, the King of Hades...!
uncertain: meiou rendered 'King of Hades' (glossary has Hades Project / Hades Attack).

rows.en: What!? You're saying I made a mistake!?
Ugh! Gh, nngh... M-my head...
Ugh, gh... ahh... My head... my...
Masato!? Masato!
Explain yourself, Miku...! Miku!
You Hakke fools! How long will you keep defying me!?
Hmm, it seems you're somewhat capable.
Hmph...! Zeorymer, what's wrong!?
Are you saying I underestimated them...?
Nngh, they did this much damage to Zeorymer!?
What's the meaning of this, Miku...!
...Correcting attack prediction program.
What...? Miku, Zeorymer can still move, I trust!
...There is no problem with operation.
Mere Hakke! Don't get cocky!
All talk.
You hit me... I might even praise you, heh heh...
Is that the best you can do?
Fool... Even when you hit, this is all you can do?
A hit? Miku, what's going on!?
Damage is minor... There is no problem...
Hoh... so you hit me.
Self-repair program... activating...
Do you understand now? Nothing works against the Heavens!
Heh heh... Fool...!
As if you could ever hit this Zeorymer!
Show me you can dodge it, Zeorymer!
Dimensional Coupler System... stable...
Did you think I couldn't see through a trick that cheap?
In the end, you lot are no match for the Heavens...!
Useless, useless, uselesss!
Heh heh heh... Not even worth dodging.
Miku! Barrier system!
Miku! Deploy the force field!
This is the power of the Dimensional Coupler System!
Miku! What's the meaning of this!
This junk... is worthless...!
Out of my way! I'll do it!
Being weak is a sin.
Miku! Dimensional Coupler System, maximum output...!
Saiga, one of the Hakkeshu. I'm making my move.
I'll prove the scientific might of the Hau Dragon.
Omzack of the Lightning has no equal.
Heh... There will be no pain. I'll end it in an instant!
Masaki Kihara... Heh... I've been dying to meet you.
Zeorymer of the Heavens... Heh... let's see what you're worth.
I'll judge whether you're worthy of the name Heavens!
Well then... I suppose I'll join in too.
I hate being bored. ...Disappear!
Defying the Lightning... How foolish.
I'll repay you as you deserve.
Impossible...! Omzack... my Lightning!
U-uoooh! Impossible!
Was I careless...? No, is it the enemy's skill!?
Omzack of the Lightning... This is unbelievable...!
Yes, Masaki Kihara... This power is... my...!
Magnificent... So this is... the power of the Heavens...!
I took more damage than expected...
It seems you're not all show... heh heh heh.
Hoh... Now it's finally getting interesting.
It seems I won't be bored after all.
Masaki Kihara... still not showing your true power!?
Zeorymer... as expected, not one to take lightly.
It hit? Hmph, no matter...
Was I slow to react...?
Heh heh heh... Omzack won't budge an inch!
I deliberately took that hit... and this is all?
Masaki... I'll have you stop playing around.
Is this the Heavens' true strength...? It can't be!
Fool... You still don't get it, do you?
To challenge me with something like this...
The Heavens missed...? Is it a ploy...?
Hahahahaha! That won't work!
As if that would work on the Lightning!
My energy...!? Ngh... I got careless!
Tch, with this much distance between us...
Ngh... I got careless!
Move! You're in the way!
I'll put the finishing touch on this.
Hmph, this is why I hate dead weight...
I won't let things go as you wish.
Take this! Proton Thunder!
Hear the roar of the Lightning!
I'll break you down to the atomic level... Vanish...!
Shi-Aen, one of the Hakkeshu. I shall face you!
This is where you'll find your grave.
Fool who defies the Hau Dragon... Vanish!
Bryst of the Fires, here I come!
The power of Fire... allow me to show you.
Here I go! Bryst, full power!
The Kihara bloodline... ends here!
Don't think Fire is inferior to the Heavens!
Zeorymer... I'll burn you to ashes!
Tau, we have to make sure we finish this one...
You understand, don't you?
I don't need to be told...!
Then I'll finish it!
That softness... will be the death of you!
I'll intercept! Prepare yourself!
So relaxed against me... I don't like it.
You underestimated Fire... Now atone for that sin!
So you dared lay a hand on this Bryst!
Defying the Hakkeshu... How foolish.
No! Bryst of the Fires... like this!
Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: Line trails off with the object only; kept as fragment 'I... you...!'.

rows.en: A direct hit!? No!
Not yet! I'm still alive!
This power... Did I underestimate the enemy!?
Bryst! Just a little more! Hold out a little more!
Even with the power of Fire... it's no good!?
I, Shi-Aen... will not die quietly!
Masaki Kihara! Even if I must take you down with me...!
As expected of the most powerful of the Hakke robots...
Interesting... It seems the real fight starts now.
It has to be at least that much, or fighting is pointless!
Heh... It seems I can finally get serious.
To do this much against Fire...
It seems you have some strength after all!
Is that your limit!? Zeorymer!
Even the Heavens can't win with this little!
Don't make me laugh!
A fool who doesn't know their place...!
Heh heh heh heh... Did you do something?
I'll admit you managed to hit Fire.
You're no match for Bryst!
It seems you can't make me get serious.
Masaki Kihara... are you mocking me!?
Zeorymer of the Heavens can't be this weak...!
Are you toying with me...?
I can't afford to be hit!
Your aim seems sloppy.
Aim properly!
Even the Heavens are nothing before Fire!
That won't work on Bryst of the Fires!
That won't work!
No... my energy!?
So you struck my blind spot...!
Not bad, against my Bryst.
Bryst of the Fires, following up!
I'll be the one to deliver the finishing blow!
I'll cover you! Fall back!
Tau! Get out of my line of fire!
I won't let you!
Don't make me look after you!
I won't let you do as you please before Fire!
Tau, you're too far forward!
Engage!
uncertain: kakaru rendered 'Engage!'; also used by Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Engage! Flare Launcheeer!!
Go! Flare Launcher!
Plasma sphere... take this!
Plasma Bullet Magrash!
Magrash! Fire!
Magraaaaash!
Plasma Bullet! Magraash!
Now feel the power of the Hakkeshu...
...We'll unleash the Twin Lord!
Understood, Sister.
Beam Searcher!
uncertain: Beam Searcher not in glossary; literal katakana reading.

rows.en: Magraaaaash!!
Beam Searcher, fire!
uncertain: Beam Searcher not in glossary; literal katakana reading.

rows.en: Magraash!!
